metaTitle: Custom Flannel Work Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom flannel work shirts in bulk. Perfect for teams needing durable, comfortable uniforms. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Flannel work shirts combine the rugged durability needed on job sites with the comfort of soft brushed cotton or cotton-blend fabrics. Unlike basic cotton tees or stiff canvas shirts, flannel offers warmth without bulk, making it ideal for outdoor crews, warehouse teams, or any staff working in cooler conditions. Choose from classic plaid patterns or solid heathers, and add your logo via embroidery or screen printing for a crisp, professional look that lasts through repeated washes.
heroAltText: Custom flannel work shirts in plaid patterns with embroidered logos, displayed on workers at a job site.
